proof_summary: Lucas congruences modulo $3$ give $A_{3m}\equiv A_m$, $A_{3m+1}\equiv-A_m$, and $A_{3m+2}\equiv A_m$, while every Apéry number is odd; hence each adjacent sum is divisible by $6$, and adding each Hankel row to its predecessor shows its determinant is divisible by $6^n$, yielding $16\cdot3^n$ after checking the small indices separately. Thus the scaled series is $1+16D$, and its integral eighth root is built recursively: the next root coefficient changes the relevant coefficient of the eighth power by $8c$, while the previously determined contribution is divisible by $16$ because all earlier nonconstant root coefficients are even.
